item.title: How We Pushed CDC into Postgres
item.description:
📝 Data mirroring is a new Snowflake Postgres feature in public preview to perform highly resilient data replication into Snowflake with low cost, low lag and transactional consistency. Under the covers, it works by pushing changes directly from Postgres into Apache Iceberg™ tables, in transactional batches. From pull to push: moving change data capture into Postgres Change data capture is the process of capturing changes from a transactional database in a form that allows them to be replayed on another system.
🔗 Read more: https://www.snowflake.com/en/blog/engineering/postgres-to-snowflake-replication-mirroring/

item.title: Georgia police officers fired after Flock camera misuse
item.description:
📝 (WTOC) - The Savannah Police Department terminated four sworn officers and two civilian employees following an internal investigation into misuse of the department’s Flock Safety License Plate Reader system. All six cases are also under independent criminal investigation by the Georgia Bureau of Investigation. What comes nextThe internal investigation is wrapped up — the six employees have been terminated.
🔗 Read more: https://www.wtoc.com/2026/08/07/savannah-police-department-fires-6-employees-over-flock-safety-system-misuse/
